# the player in the APK: backend (from the APK); abis = the APK's ABIs the port runs, and so
# the runtimes the release ships (armeabi-v7a: ua_host, 32-bit; arm64-v8a: ua_host64); abi = the
# one taken where the system runs both: auto = armeabi-v7a where the system has a 32-bit
# userland, else arm64-v8a; arm64-v8a = the 64-bit one wherever the APK has it; il2cpp = true
# (a Mono build, armeabi-v7a only): where the system has no 32-bit userland, the setup compiles
# the build's code with Unity's IL2CPP for Unity's arm64 IL2CPP player (hours on the handheld,
# Wi-Fi, about 1.6 GB free; the release also ships ua_host64)
